summary: Iteration 3 (INR+USD currency, brand icons, redesigned tab bar) tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 new currency pytest cases PASS (test_currency_api.py) covering signup defaults primary_currency=INR, all 12 seeded subs have currency field with >=6 INR and >=3 USD, POST /api/subscriptions/reset wipes+re-seeds returning count=12, Netflix ₹649/INR & ChatGPT Plus $20/USD verified after reset, currency persists on POST + PUT, /auth/preferences updates primary_currency, invalid currency ignored, /insights returns primary_currency and monthly_total converts correctly (₹8,664 INR → $104.39 USD ≈ inr_total/83), basic_summary carries ₹ or $ per user preference, /reminders items include currency. Frontend (mobile 390x844): logged in as demo user (auto-reset already produced iteration-3 dataset). Dashboard hero shows 'TOTAL MONTHLY · INR' with ₹8,664 and compact '₹1.0L / year'. Reminder rows and Coming-up list render each sub in NATIVE currency (ChatGPT Plus $20.00, Spotify Premium ₹119, Netflix ₹649, iCloud+ $0.99, Notion Personal Pro $8.00). Calendar timeline: per-row amounts native, summary cards 'NEXT 7 DAYS ₹1,928' and 'NEXT 30 DAYS ₹10,935' are aggregated in primary currency. Tapping profile-currency once switched primary→USD; dashboard updated to '$104.39 monthly / $1,252.68 yearly', Spending mix now $-values, timeline cards $23.23/$131.75, per-sub rows still native. Redesigned tab bar renders 5 tabs with icon + label (Home/Subs/Calendar/AI/You), badge testID='tab-badge-dashboard' shows '2' active reminders, all tabs tappable and navigate correctly (URLs /dashboard, /subscriptions, /calendar, /insights, /profile). form-currency in edit form cycles INR→USD→EUR (verified 3 states with symbol/code display). subs-add-btn / dashboard-add-sub / dashboard-scan-gmail testIDs present. profile-reset-data testID present. BrandAvatar: Netflix/Spotify/OpenAI/Notion/Zomato brand logos rendered (real favicon load succeeded for the reachable services); for services blocked by ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED (Adobe, Demo initial) the initial-letter fallback is visible (e.g. 'A' for Adobe, 'D' for Demo avatar), exercising the chained fallback. Regressions: 7 stale tests in test_suborganizer_api.py + test_reminders_api.py fail — all failures are due to intentional iteration-3 seed changes (12 subs not 11, 'Spotify Premium' not 'Spotify', 'iCloud+ 50GB' not 'iCloud+', YouTube Premium removed, Amazon Prime now yearly) — these are NOT product bugs, tests need updating. Cosmetic: 'shadow*' deprecation warning and 'transform-origin' DOM warning persist from iteration 1/2 (unchanged, non-blocking).

issues: Deprecated 'shadow*' StyleSheet props still used in reminders.tsx, dashboard.tsx heroCard, and tabs _layout.tsx pill container — React Native Web logs a warning on every render. Migrate to boxShadow to silence.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeat from iteration 1/2 — 'shadow*' style props deprecated on RN Web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/reminders.tsx, /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx, /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx (styles.heroCard).
Console error 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' persists — cosmetic only; animations still work.

action_items: LOW: Update stale regression tests in /app/backend/tests/test_suborganizer_api.py (test_signup_seeds_11_subs → expect 12; test_list_demo_has_11 → drop 'Spotify'/adjust name to 'Spotify Premium') and /app/backend/tests/test_reminders_api.py (rename 'Spotify' → 'Spotify Premium', drop 'YouTube Premium' fixture references, rename 'iCloud+' → 'iCloud+ 50GB', re-pick a monthly sub with small offset for Keep test).
LOW/cosmetic: Migrate 'shadow*' → 'boxShadow' across StyleSheets. Fix reanimated 'transform-origin' → 'transformOrigin' in the tab-bar pill or upgrade adapter.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is now 498 lines — still under 700-line threshold. RATES + to_inr + _monthly_in_currency are a clean, testable currency-conversion layer.

PreferencesIn.primary_currency validates against the RATES dict (rejects unknown codes silently instead of raising 400) — acceptable UX, but consider returning 200 with an 'ignored' flag or a 400 to surface bad input.

reset_seed correctly deletes ALL user subs (including custom ones the user might have added). This is expected for a 'demo reset' but a small confirmation dialog on the frontend is already implemented — good.
serialize_sub gracefully defaults currency to 'INR' when a legacy doc lacks the field — safe migration path.
insights conversion: monthly = sum(_monthly_in_currency) using INR as pivot — verified inr_total ≈ usd_total * 83 within 2% tolerance.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 new currency suite); prior suites 16/23 — the 7 failures are stale-data expectations, not product regressions
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 3 fix areas (currency display + conversion, brand icons w/ fallback, redesigned tab bar). All requested testIDs present and functional.

seed_data_creation: Backend test users TEST_cur_<hex>@example.com (currency suite) — auto-seeded with 12 mixed-currency subs. Demo user demo@suborganizer.app was reset via POST /api/subscriptions/reset during TestReset — it now has the iteration-3 dataset (Netflix ₹649, ChatGPT Plus $20, Spotify Premium ₹119, iCloud+ $0.99, Disney+ Hotstar ₹1,499/yr, JioSaavn Pro ₹99, Swiggy One ₹149, Zomato Gold ₹199, Amazon Prime ₹1,499/yr, The Ken ₹2,750/yr, Notion Personal Pro $8, Adobe CC $54.99). Demo primary_currency temporarily flipped to USD then reverted to INR during frontend test but the flip may still be USD if test was cut — the value is idempotent (Profile currency stat is tap-to-cycle).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env key in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Iteration-3 seed pack = 12 subs (8 INR + 4 USD). Currency testIDs: form-currency (cycle button, label reads e.g. '₹\nINR'), profile-currency, profile-reset-data, dashboard-total-amount, tab-badge-dashboard, tab-{dashboard,subscriptions,calendar,insights,profile}. FX table is static in server.py RATES: USD=83, EUR=90, GBP=105, JPY=0.56, AED=22.6, CAD=61, AUD=55, SGD=62. If demo user's primary_currency looks odd from a previous test run, POST /api/auth/preferences {primary_currency:'INR'} to reset. External favicon services (clearbit/google/duckduckgo) fail with ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED inside the sandbox for some domains — this is expected and exercises the initial-letter fallback path; do not treat as a bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in the three iteration-3 fix areas. The 7 failing tests in the older suites (test_suborganizer_api.py / test_reminders_api.py) all fail because their fixtures assume the pre-iteration-3 seed pack (11 subs, 'Spotify'/'iCloud+'/'YouTube Premium'). The main agent should refresh those fixtures to the new dataset names/counts; the underlying backend behavior for the assertions themselves is still correct (verified via test_currency_api.py + smoke checks).
